sloka: प्रहस्य विकृतं भीमं स मेघस्तनितोपमम्।कुम्भकर्णो महातेजा राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६७.१३५ ।।
transliteration: prahasya vikṛtaṁ bhīmaṁ sa meghastanitopamam।kumbhakarṇo mahātejā rāghavaṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 6.67.135 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the Vanaras shaken, Rama went towards the Rakshasa instantly and took out his best bow.
